Only 22% of remote USD jobs list a salary figure. The rest are marked DOE—determined on experience.

Our latest analysis of 4,280 active remote listings shows 940 disclose pay, while 78% leave it blank. But a hidden figure isn't always a red flag—it can be a negotiation lever.

Key numbers:
• 4,280 active remote listings worldwide
• 940 (22%) state a concrete USD figure
• 3,340 (78%) imply DOE
• 2,735 (64%) accept applicants from any country
• 1,213 posted in the last 7 days

Example: Online Consumer Panels America offers $25–$45/hour for product assessments—no experience needed.

DOE roles can push salaries above market averages for top candidates, especially in AI, senior leadership, or specialized medical roles.
